Settings » General Settings » Social Media Tab
## Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558389
This article reviews links for the Social Media accounts for the website,  members and visitors will be able to access the full spectrum of profiles available for the website and it helps link the social media world to the website

## Social Media Accounts
Below is a full list of the Social Media accounts linked to the website.
Important note: The system will ask for absolute URLs. For example:
• facebook.comwillnotbe accepted
• https://www.facebook.comwill be accepted

## 1. Facebook
Add a link to the website's facebook account using the following format: https://www.facebook.com/CompanyFacebook

## 2. Twitter
Add a link to the website's Twitter account using the following format: https://www.twitter.com/CompanyTwitter

## 3. LinkedIn
Add a link to the website's LinkedIn account using the following format: https://www.linkedin.com/CompanyLinkedIn

## 4. Pinterest
Add a link to the website's Pinterest account using the following format: https://www.pinterest.com/CompanyPinteres

## 5. Instagram
Add a link to the website's Instagram account using the following format: https://www.instagram.com/CompanyInstagram

## 6. Youtube
Add a link to the website's Youtube account using the following format: https://www.youtube.com/CompanyYouTube

## 7. RSS Feed
Add a link to the website's RSS feed using the following format: https://www.yourwebsite.com/rss

## 8. Tik Tok
Add a link to the website's TikTok account using the following format: https://www.tiktok.com/@name

## 9. Whatsapp
Add a link to the website's WhatsApp account using the following format: https://wa.me/1XXXXXXXXXX

## 10. Snapchat
Add a link to the website's Snapchat accout using the following format: https://www.snapchat.com/add/username

## Where Do These Links Appear?
Inside the Footer Menu of the website:
